changeSet.author: fund-transfer-user-service

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name = 'user_service'

changeSet.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS user_service;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON SCHEMA user_service TO "fund-transfer";
ALTER ROLE "fund-transfer" SET search_path TO user_service, public;
changeSet.rollback: DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS user_service CASCADE;
